source.boundary: The Al Ewing section and its 11 selected rows in the owner compilation.
source.permission: The owner supplied his own factual compilation. Only factual issue selections and supporting evidence are reproduced here. No source prose, comic image bytes or license grant is inferred.

sourceTableRows.title: Venom (2021)
sourceTableRows.selection: Shared Ewing/Ram V collection route; verified opening #1-10

sourceTableRows.title: Defenders (2021); Defenders: Beyond (2022)
sourceTableRows.selection: #1-5 of each; Ewing material from Marvel Comics #1000-1001

storyQualifications.fact: The named ongoing issues are selected; references to omnibus extras do not add one-shots or Gamma Flight.
The selected Loki issues may include material with additional writers.
The 2015 and 2016 Ultimates series are distinct from the earlier Ultimate-universe Ultimates.
The selection ends with the original 2023 Immortal Thor series and does not add later relaunches.
The selected 2020 S.W.O.R.D. series is distinct from the 2009 series.
X-Men Red #1-18 is explicitly a reading pool. The source notes an anomalous writer credit on #16 and does not assert sole authorship.
The 2021 Guardians annual selects Ewing material; the included item is the whole issue.
Venom #1-10 is a shared Ewing and Ram V selection, not an assertion of exclusive Ewing authorship or a complete run.
Marvel Comics #1000-1001 selects Ewing material; the included items are whole anthology issues.

identityInterpretations.evidence: The complete 2019 provider series response and the individually verified issue details contain the two named issues.

writerCreditEvidence.fact: The provider lists no writer; an independent story credit names Al Ewing.
The provider lists no writer; an independent story credit names Al Ewing.
The provider credits Ram. V. but not Ewing; the selected Venom reading pool explicitly includes issues by both.
The provider writer fields omit Ewing, whose anthology contributions are independently reported.

ownerDecision: One list in release order, so his series interleave as he wrote them (Recommended)

manifestProposal.name: Al Ewing Reading List
manifestProposal.description: Read Al Ewing's Marvel comics in the order they came out, including Immortal Hulk, Loki, X-Men Red, Immortal Thor and the Ultimates. Some comics include stories by other writers.
manifestProposal.sourceOrigin: Selected by the Recap Page team

checklistIntroduction: The Recap Page team selected these comics. They are listed by release date. Some comics include stories by other writers.

ordering.rule: Order by the metadata provider on-sale date, earliest first. For the same date, retain first source-occurrence order.

sourceRows.seriesYearBasis: The source does not name this anthology series year; the provider index identifies its 2019 series.
The source does not name this anthology series year; the provider index identifies its 2019 series.

writers.rule: Catalog writers are the three most frequent credited writers present on at least one quarter of included issues.

universeProposal.evidence: The source does not name one reality for the complete creator selection.
